subject: Evaluation handoff: validation playbook & acceptance probes

Subject: Re: Pilot next steps — validation scope and acceptance tests

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We liked the latency profile and the ability to pin models per-route. Before we put this in front of our clinical QA team, we need a short, concrete validation playbook that we can run in parallel with a 4-week pilot.

Top asks from our end:
- A concise list of acceptance probes (what we run, expected pass/fail thresholds) — ideally runnable by our QA engineers.
- Clear exit gates (what constitutes a fail vs acceptable risk for Go/No-Go).
- An evidence bundle we can hand to compliance for retention & access logs.

We’re targeting a mid-September decision (commit or stop) and would like to lock the MAP so owners + dates are explicit. Can you send a first-pass playbook and a proposed timeline by next Tuesday?

Regards,
Jamie Ortiz
Head of Integrations, HealthGrid
jamie.ortiz@healthgrid.com
(415) 555-0132

Subject: Re: Pilot next steps — validation scope and acceptance tests

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Draft MAP and a short validation playbook attached; high level below. We can iterate Tuesday as you requested.

Summary (first pass):
- Pilot length: 4 weeks (Aug 30 — Sep 26)
- Primary success criteria: mean generation latency < 220ms P50 and concordance > 92% on the provided evaluation set
- Exit gates: (1) critical security gaps unresolved (2) < 85% concordance after 2 iterations of prompt/quantization tuning (3) sustained P95 latency > 900ms for > 15% of requests under pilot load
- Acceptance probes: 12 automated scripts (see Acceptance_Probe_Scripts.md) covering throughput, latency, hallucination checks on 500 sample prompts, and KV-cache warmup behavior
- Evidence bundle: retention policy note + trace IDs export procedure + sample audit logs (SOC2 index attached)

Owners and milestones (high level):
- Week 0 (Aug 23–29): onboarding & access (Marissa owner)
- Week 1 (Aug 30–Sep 5): smoke tests + baseline measurements (Karthik owner)
- Week 2 (Sep 6–12): probe run #1, tuning & mitigation (Karthik + Marissa)
- Week 3 (Sep 13–19): probe run #2, regression tests (Marissa owner)
- Week 4 (Sep 20–26): final evidence package & decision readout (Vanessa owner)

I attached MAP_HealthGrid_v1.xlsx for the mutual action plan with owners, deliverables, and dates. Quick Q: do you have a preferred concordance metric (BLEU vs task-specific scoring) or should we align on your clinical QA’s current rubric?

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot next steps — validation scope and acceptance tests

Hi team — adding a technical lens. Short answers and practical recommendations below.

Concordance metric: we suggest a two-tier approach so results are meaningful for clinicians and actionable for infra tuning:
- Primary: task-specific scoring (your clinical QA rubric) mapped to a 0–100 passband (we can help map classification thresholds).
- Secondary: automated semantic similarity (embedding cosine + threshold) to catch near-miss equivalence in free-text outputs.

Acceptance probes (excerpt):
1) Latency smoke — 1k requests across 3 model routes at pilot concurrency (measure P50/P95) — fail if P95 > 900ms.
2) Regression harness — 500 golden prompts + expected response patterns; fail if concordance < 92% post-tuning.
3) Hallucination spot-check — 100 prompts with negative-controls; flag high severity if > 3% high-risk hallucinations.
4) Statefulness/KV cache — run long-session workloads to validate KV retention and per-token cost improvement (target > 25% token cost reduction after cache warmup).

Instrumentation notes: capture trace IDs and attach per-run token breakdowns. I’ve added scripts to Acceptance_Probe_Scripts.md. I’ll be available for a call Monday to walk your QA through the scripts.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Please update the MAP and evidence checklist; once updated we’ll sign the MAP and lock onboarding Aug 30. Looking forward to the Monday walkthrough.

Best,
Jamie
